map.算法：房间体积 = 面积×层高；层高系数 = max(层高/3, 0.8)；围护: Algorithm: room volume = area times ceiling height; ceiling-height factor = max(ceiling height / 3, 0.8); envelope load = area times 120 times orientation factor times ceiling-height factor (north 0.9, south 1.0, east 1.1, west 1.2, top floor 1.25); occupant load = count times 150 W; lighting load = area times 20 W; total cooling load is the sum of the three; required cooling = total cooling load times 1.15; computed horsepower = required cooling / 2500; recommended horsepower = ceil(computed horsepower times 2) / 2 (round up to 0.5 hp), then give the model by recommended horsepower.
map.例：30m²、层高 3m、西向、4 人 → 体积 90m³、层高系数 1，围护: Example: 30 m2, ceiling height 3 m, west, 4 persons gives volume 90 m3, ceiling factor 1, envelope 4320 W plus occupant 600 W plus lighting 600 W = total 5520 W, required 6348 W (6.35 kW), computed 2.54 hp, recommended 3 hp, model 2.5 to 3 hp floor-standing unit (living room). 15 m2, ceiling 2.8 m, north, 2 persons gives ceiling factor 0.9333, envelope 1512 W, total 2112 W, required 2429 W, recommended 1 hp (1 hp wall-mounted unit, small bedroom). 60 m2, top floor, 10 persons gives total 11700 W, required 13455 W, recommended 5.5 hp, suggests multiple units or a central AC system.
